title: connectome-control: the C. elegans connectome as a trainable cart-pole controller
description: Code and data for a pre-registered study training leaky-integrator recurrent networks masked by the C. elegans connectome (OpenWorm c302 herm_full_edgelist) to swing up and balance a cart-pole from positions-only observations under a 20 ms action delay. Includes the protocol-v4 training/evaluation pipeline, typed degree-preserving graph controls (full and partial rewiring), relay-distillation teachers, multi-machine deterministic job queue, all per-run results and manifests, pre-registered analyses, and the interactive web demo.
